# The Piste Office

> > UK ski and snowboard servicing specialist offering Dominator Zoom Wax, Quiver Killer products, and professional tuning tools from Skiman and Kunzmann.

Run by Ori Reiss in Golders Green, London, The Piste Office provides retail products, tuning services, and educational resources for DIY ski maintenance. The site features comprehensive guides on edge tuning, waxing techniques, and workshop setup.

## Key Topics

- Ski tuning and maintenance
- Edge filing and sharpening
- Dominator Zoom Wax
- Quiver Killer inserts
- Kunzmann tuning tools
- Skiman edge guides
- Side edge tuning techniques
- Base edge filing
- P-tex base repair
- Ski waxing brushes
- DIY tuning workshops
- Binding mounting
- Snowboard servicing
- Boot fitting recommendations
- Professional ski equipment

## Tuning Guides & Tutorials

- [Tuning Guide](https://pisteoffice.com/blogs/tuning-guide): Tutorial index: Side & base edge tuning, burr removal techniques
- [Side Edge Tuning](https://pisteoffice.com/blogs/tuning-guide/side-edge-tuning): Tutorial: Side edge filing, stoning & polishing with angle guides
- [Terminology](https://pisteoffice.com/blogs/tuning-advice/terminology): Reference: Ski construction, P-Tex bases & edge angle terminology
- [Tuning Bench Design](https://pisteoffice.com/blogs/tuning-advice/tuning-bench-design): Guide: DIY ski tuning workbench design & workshop setup tips
- [Zardoz Base Boost](https://pisteoffice.com/blogs/tuning-guide/zardoz-notwax): Guide: Zardoz Base Boost teflon coating for wet snow conditions
